# Reiki

Security proxy for agent and LLM traffic: isolates keys, filters what leaves, keeps access reliable.

- [README](README.md): install, proof-first quickstart, configuration, operations and security model.
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): build, test, lint, docs-check commands, repo map and conventions.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): private reporting, supported versions and response targets.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): release notes by version and section.

## Start

- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): the reading order and every page.
- [Quickstart](docs/quickstart.md): proof-first setup with expected output and a negative test.
- [Overview](docs/overview.md): model, listeners and request path.
- [Glossary](docs/glossary.md): CLI and status vocabulary.
- [Command line](docs/cli.md): every subcommand, flag and exit code.
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): every table, field, default and validation rule.

## Keys, traffic and providers

- [Keys and streams](docs/keys.md): key files, hashes, chains and dynamic stream credentials.
- [Providers](docs/providers.md): upstream mapping, provider status and test coverage.
- [Clients](docs/clients.md): client base URLs, tokens, proof checks and bypasses.
- [Failover](docs/failover.md): chains, response rules, cooldowns and key states.
- [Shaping](docs/shaping.md): outbound limits and stream admission.
- [Dynamic streams](docs/dynamic-streams.md): operating the opt-in stream admin API, audit and backups.

## Security and data

- [Security](docs/security.md): assets, trust boundaries, redaction, limits and release verification.
- [Plugins](docs/plugins.md): build-time plugin set, order and egress controls.
- [Plugin authoring](docs/plugin-authoring.md): hooks, tests, registration and Wasm host.
- [Cost](docs/cost.md): opt-in accounting and export.
- [Tunnel](docs/tunnel.md): opaque CONNECT and TLS interception.
- [Request log](docs/requestlog.md): summary records and optional masked capture.

## Operate

- [Deploy](docs/deploy.md): install, directory layout, service setup, reload, upgrade and rollback.
- [Monitoring](docs/monitoring.md): admin routes, status, metrics and health checks.
- [Provider health](docs/provider-health.md): read-only peer health contract and endpoint.
- [Top](docs/top.md): live fleet view.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): exact messages and fixes.
